div.head: VI Atr 23.1
div.ab: And sancte Eadwardes mæssedæg witan habbað gecoran, þæt man freolsian sceal ofer eall Englaland on XV kl. Aprilis.
[And sancte Eadwardes mæssedæg witan habbað gecoran þæt man freolsian sceal ofer eall Englaland on XV kl. Aprilis.]
(Und des heiligen Eadward [des Märtyrers] Fest haben die Witan entschieden, dass über ganz England am 18. März gefeiert werden soll. D)
(And the witan have decided that the feast of St Edward [the Martyr] is to be celebrated throughout all England on 18 March. D)
[And the authorities have decided that St Edward’s festival shall be celebrated throughout England on the 18th of March.]
div.note: 23.1 follows only in D, as in V Atr 16 and I Cn 17.1.

note.seg: This clause is found only in D; cf. V, 16.
